comments.value:
This was anecdotal and incidental on VRChat 2025.4.2p1 (Build 1769) observed by me (as "Bob") and several friends (other "Bobs") in an instance, but I don't logs or screenshots/video to share of that incident, only reproduction steps and even then I'm not sure if this issue remains reproducible or if the steps to reproduce are even correct (1 or 3 months delay limitation between display name changes).

This was in a typical world with native VRChat nameplates, without custom nameplates created or set by the world's scripts.

details:
VRChat nameplates above an user's head may continue to display incorrect, old display name information (temporarily) after a name change on the website.

1. Alice and Bob (friends) join an instance ([VRChat Home](https://vrchat.com/home/world/wrld_4432ea9b-729c-46e3-8eaf-846aa0a37fdd/info) world) and observe Alice's nameplate together.

2. Alice uses the VRChat Home website and navigates to [Account Settings](https://vrchat.com/home/profile) to change their display name to Carol.

3. Bob observes Alice/Carol's nameplate for a display name again shortly after.

4. Carol rejoins the instance shortly after (without restarting VRChat client) to create leave/join notifications, while Bob waits for Carol to rejoin.

5. Bob observes Alice/Carol's display name in leave/join notifications.

6. Bob observes Alice/Carol's nameplate for a display name once more shortly after.

7. Bob opens Alice/Carol's profile/bio in-app and observes the display name in profile.

Expected result: After Alice changes her display name to Carol, Bob sees the new display name (Carol) displayed on the nameplate (at step 3 or 6), in join notifications and in the user's profile in-app to other users.

Actual result: Bob sees the user's old display name (Alice) displayed on the nameplate at all times instead of the new display name (Carol), even after Alice/Carol rejoined the instance. Bob sees join notifications and the user's profile display the new display name (Carol) in-app.
title: Display names on nameplates are not updated immediately in-app when a display name is changed on the VRChat Home website
